description: Come celebrate my condo-warming party with me! I'm inviting you to come connect with me and get to know our neighbors in our district in my new (soon to be) home! Suggested donation is $25, but a contribution of any size is graciously accepted as an RSVP. RSVP here: https://secure.actblue.com/d
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends to Elect Connie Steinmetz; Jean Hammer, Treasurer
title: Connie’s Condo-Warming Party! — Connie Steinmetz for MO House District 87
